example.title: Hauge Norwegian Evangelical Lutheran Church, State Route 78
example.source: HABS WI-240 (photos/drawings via Wikimedia Commons mirror of HABS)

brief: The first Norwegian Lutheran church west of Madison (1852): an all-log building later sided with white clapboard, a simple two-storey-high gable-roofed box with no tower, shuttered 6/6 windows in two tiers, a plain side door and wood-shingle roof, standing alone in a grassy country churchyard. HABS drawings record the original furnishings and log construction.
